brief:
Israeli occupation forces abducted a young man during an incursion into the village of Briqah in Quneitra countryside in southern Syria, Shehab Wire reported citing Syria's official news channel. The raid occurred as Israeli forces carried out operations in the region.

The abduction marks the latest incident involving Israeli military activity in the Syrian territory near the occupied Golan Heights, an area that has seen repeated cross-border operations.
